title: Naming contract
subtitle: One name must match letter-for-letter across .gui / .txt / loc — welded automatically, double-checked here.
mockVarsHint: Values feed the canvas preview; unset variables count as 0.
mockVarsEmpty: No [?var] references or frame variables on this panel yet.
scanFailed: Contract check unavailable — the panel still saves and exports normally.
scanNote: The contract check runs against the last saved state — save the panel to re-check draft changes.
notCheckedNote: Not checked here: whether the window name clashes with a base-game window or an imported GUI file, and whether the sprites exist.
code_token_collision_title: Two panels derive the same names
code_token_collision_suggestion: Rename one panel token so the derived files no longer overwrite each other.
code_control_collision_title: Two controls derive the same name
code_control_collision_suggestion: Rename the controls so their derived names differ — duplicates silently overwrite each other in .gui/.txt/loc.
code_raw_dirty_invalid_suggestion: The raw dirty value is not a single-token variable name, so the export uses the derived variable instead - fix the value or remove the key.
code_unknown_scripted_suggestion: Define it in the Scripted Effects and Triggers workbench, or use a vanilla trigger/effect.
code_sprite_empty_suggestion: The control renders as nothing until a GFX_* sprite name is set.
code_loc_blank_suggestion: Blank text renders as an empty control in-game — fill it with one click, then save.
